# vastdata_de_engine (Resource)

Unified status for Data Engine setup and deletion operations

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage Data Engine for a tenant via POST/GET/DELETE /serverless/data-engine/
# (not the deprecated /setup-provisioning endpoint).
#
# Tenant-admin: set provider.tenant (or omit tenant_name when already scoped).
# Cluster admin: pass tenant_name on the resource (API query).
#
# Prerequisites (e.g. modules/dataengine_vms_setup): tenant, VIP pool,
# S3-native broker view/bucket, and Kafka topics.

provider "vastdata" {
  host     = "vast-cluster"
  username = "admin"
  password = "******"
  # tenant = "de-lab"  # optional for tenant-admin auth
}

resource "vastdata_de_engine" "this" {
  tenant_name            = "de-lab" # required for cluster-admin auth
  default_topic_name     = "engine-main"
  dead_letter_topic_name = "engine-deadletter"

  kafka_broker = {
    name = "de-lab-broker" # Internal: broker view/bucket name
    type = "Internal"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dead_letter_topic_name` (String) The name of the dead letter topic
- `default_topic_name` (String) The name of the default topic
- `kafka_broker` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka_broker))

### Optional

- `kafka_ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) Optional CA certificate for Kafka broker (Base64 encoded). Must be provided if the Kafka broker is using TLS.
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.
- `vip_pools` (Set of Number) VIP Pools to use for the telemetries collector

### Read-Only

- `deletion` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deletion))
- `deprecated_api_used` (Boolean) True if the request came from a deprecated endpoint
- `setup` (Attributes) Status of the Data Engine setup process (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--setup))

<a id="nestedatt--kafka_broker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka_broker`

Required:

- `name` (String) Broker name for external or Bucket (View) name for internal.
- `type` (String)

Optional:

- `is_accessible_to_data_engine` (Boolean) When true (default), the Data Engine will periodically validate that the broker is accessible. Set to false if the broker is not reachable from the Data Engine (e.g., external brokers behind firewalls).
- `url` (String) Deprecated. The broker URL is now resolved from VMS by broker name. This field is ignored for VMS-registered brokers and only used as a legacy fallback for brokers not yet registered in VMS. It will be removed in a future release.


<a id="nestedatt--deletion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deletion`

Required:

- `status` (String) The current status of the data engine deletion process

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Status message or error details
- `started_at` (String) When the deletion process was started


<a id="nestedatt--setup"></a>
### Nested Schema for `setup`

Required:

- `status` (String) The current status of the Data Engine setup process

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Current status message or error details
- `parameters` (Attributes) Request body for setting up Data Engine (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--setup--parameters))
- `started_at` (String) When the setup process was started
